entities.name: János Váradi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: János Váradi is a retired Hungarian boxer, who won the bronze medal in the flyweight division at the 1980 Summer Olympics. He also captured the silver medals at the 1987 and 1989 European Amateur Boxing Championships.
